strings.zh: 贴心的告示牌！{SCROLL}我们东南联盟,{NEWLINE}因平凡的你而伟大！
strings.en: Trainer Tips!{SCROLL}The Southeast League: great because of{NEWLINE}ordinary folks like you!

strings.zh: 这里是１３号道路{NEWLINE}北　寂静之桥
strings.en: Rt. 13{NEWLINE}North to Silence Bridge

strings.zh: 北　紫苑镇{NEWLINE}西　浅红市
strings.en: North to Lavender Town{NEWLINE}West to Fuchsia City

strings.zh: 力量就是真理,{NEWLINE}我的精灵都格外擅长物理型攻击,{CLEAR}你要跟我比试比试吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Strength is truth! My Pokémon are{NEWLINE}especially good at physical attacks.{CLEAR}Want to have a match with me?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 你会害怕也是应该的,{NEWLINE}毕竟我的实力在东南联盟里{CLEAR}可是数一数二的。
strings.en: It’s only natural you’re scared. After{NEWLINE}all, I’m one of the strongest in the{CLEAR}Southeast League.

strings.zh: 好,你就好好感受一下{NEWLINE}我这爆炸性的力量吧！
strings.en: All right, feel the full force of my{NEWLINE}explosive power!

strings.zh: 在力量上完全输给你了,{NEWLINE}跟你的这场战斗让我学到了很多啊,{CLEAR}这个送给你作为谢礼吧。
strings.en: You beat me completely on strength. I{NEWLINE}learned a lot from this battle. Take{CLEAR}this as thanks.

strings.zh: 我拿到6枚徽章之后,{NEWLINE}就再也无法通过第7枚徽章的测试了。{CLEAR}可能我人生的极限就到这里了吧。
strings.en: After I got my sixth Badge, I could{NEWLINE}never pass the test for the seventh.{CLEAR}Maybe that’s as far as I go in life.

strings.zh: 我特别喜欢{NEWLINE}水系精灵的那种温柔可爱,{CLEAR}以及它们可爱外表下的坚强勇敢。{CLEAR}你要感受下我的水系精灵的魅力吗？
strings.en: I just love how gentle and cute{NEWLINE}Water-type Pokémon are, and how{CLEAR}strong and brave they are under those{CLEAR}cute looks. Want to feel the charm of{CLEAR}my Water types?

strings.zh: 咦？你不喜欢水系精灵啊。
strings.en: Huh? You don’t like Water types?

strings.zh: 看我和我的精灵们{NEWLINE}一起跳起水之舞！
strings.en: Watch me and my Pokémon perform the{NEWLINE}Water Dance together!

strings.zh: 你还真是厉害呢。{NEWLINE}我得向你好好学习呀。{CLEAR}作为咱们两个这场比试的纪念,{CLEAR}请你收下这个吧。
strings.en: You’re really good! I should learn from{NEWLINE}you. Please take this as a keepsake of{CLEAR}our match.

strings.zh: 我的职业是一名救生员,{NEWLINE}所以我的对战水平挺有限的。{CLEAR}如果你想了解更多水系口袋妖怪的事,{CLEAR}华蓝道馆应该是个不错的去处。
strings.en: I’m a lifeguard by trade, so my battling{NEWLINE}skills are pretty limited. If you want to{CLEAR}learn more about Water-type Pokémon,{CLEAR}the Cerulean Gym would be a good place{CLEAR}to go.

strings.zh: 我这快如闪电的招式{NEWLINE}可是在枯叶市跟马志士大人学的,{CLEAR}你有办法战胜我吗？
strings.en: I learned my lightning-fast moves from{NEWLINE}the great Lt. Surge himself in Vermilion{CLEAR}City. Think you can beat me?

strings.zh: 别害羞嘛,来这里就是要体验{NEWLINE}挑战道馆的那种氛围才有意思啊。
strings.en: Don’t be shy! The fun of coming here is{NEWLINE}getting a taste of what a Gym challenge{CLEAR}feels like!

strings.zh: 来吧,让你看看海上男儿的志气！
strings.en: Come on, I’ll show you the grit of a man{NEWLINE}of the sea!

strings.zh: 谢谢你能给我上了一课,{NEWLINE}让我学到了很多东西。{CLEAR}作为交换,{CLEAR}我可以把我的绝招闪电拳{CLEAR}教给你的精灵。{CLEAR}你如果想学的话随时可以来找我。
strings.en: Thanks for teaching me a lesson. I{NEWLINE}learned a lot. In return, I can teach{CLEAR}your Pokémon my specialty, Thunder{CLEAR}Punch. Come find me anytime if you want{CLEAR}to learn it.

strings.zh: 哦？想让你的精灵学习闪电拳吗？
strings.en: Oh? Want your Pokémon to learn Thunder{NEWLINE}Punch?

strings.zh: 赌桌上我是常胜将军,{NEWLINE}精灵对战中我亦是常胜将军,{CLEAR}你有信心能战胜我吗？
strings.en: At the gambling table I never lose, and{NEWLINE}in Pokémon battles I never lose either.{CLEAR}Think you can beat me?

strings.zh: 怕什么呀,{NEWLINE}你是没见过超能力者吗？
strings.en: What’s there to be scared of? Never{NEWLINE}seen a psychic before?

strings.zh: 我曾经在彩虹市游戏厅出老千,{NEWLINE}结果被游戏厅的主管发现了,{CLEAR}他们当时直接就砍掉了我的右手。{CLEAR}我现在的右手其实是义肢。
strings.en: I once cheated at the Celadon Game{NEWLINE}Corner, and the manager caught me.{SCROLL}They chopped off my right hand on the{NEWLINE}spot.{SCROLL}My right hand is actually a prosthetic{NEWLINE}now.
strings.notes: Cheater’s hand cut off by the Game Corner manager; kept faithful.

strings.zh: 跟我战斗是你的不幸！
strings.en: Battling me is your bad luck!

strings.zh: 赢得漂亮,{NEWLINE}你的战斗可真是让我大开眼界。{CLEAR}这份礼物代表我的敬佩之情,{CLEAR}请收下吧。
strings.en: Beautifully won! Your battling really{NEWLINE}opened my eyes. Please accept this gift{CLEAR}as a sign of my admiration.

strings.zh: 大叔我啊,{NEWLINE}可是个精灵对战的痴迷者呢,{CLEAR}有信心能战胜我吗？
strings.en: This old guy here is crazy about{NEWLINE}Pokémon battles. Think you can beat me?

strings.zh: 是嫌弃大叔我么……
strings.en: Too good for an old guy like me, huh...

strings.zh: 大叔我啊,{NEWLINE}人到中年、妻离子散一事无成,{CLEAR}这辈子唯一的美好回忆{CLEAR}就是年轻时候周游各地时{CLEAR}赢得的这4枚徽章了。
strings.en: This old guy is middle-aged, separated{NEWLINE}from his wife and kids, and has nothing{CLEAR}to show for his life. My only good{CLEAR}memories are these four Badges I won{CLEAR}traveling around when I was young.
strings.notes: | D-1771: user approved source-faithful wording during full English review.

strings.zh: 嘿嘿,让你看看{NEWLINE}我想破脑袋想出来的战术！
strings.en: Heh heh, let me show you the strategy I{NEWLINE}racked my brains to come up with!

strings.zh: 虽然输了,{NEWLINE}但是大叔我玩得很开心呢。{CLEAR}谢谢你愿意跟我对战,{CLEAR}这个送给你吧。
strings.en: I lost, but this old guy had a lot of{NEWLINE}fun.{SCROLL}Thanks for battling me. Here, take this.

strings.zh: 是不是因为闻到我身上的香气{NEWLINE}才在这里驻足的？
strings.en: Did you stop here because you caught{NEWLINE}the scent of my perfume?

strings.zh: 嘻嘻,看不出来你还挺有品味嘛。
strings.en: Tee-hee, you’ve got better taste than{NEWLINE}you look.

strings.zh: 我在香水店当学徒的时候,{NEWLINE}经常因为调出来的味道奇怪而被骂。{SCROLL}不过现在我终于可以{NEWLINE}按我的思路调制香水了,{CLEAR}想调什么气味都可以的感觉{CLEAR}真是太好啦！
strings.en: When I was an apprentice at a perfume{NEWLINE}shop, I always got chewed out for mixing{CLEAR}weird scents.{SCROLL}But now I can finally make perfume my{NEWLINE}own way. Being free to mix any scent I{CLEAR}want feels so great!

strings.zh: 什么嘛,那你就是想跟我对战咯！
strings.en: What? So you just want to battle me,{NEWLINE}then!

strings.zh: 你的精灵虽然强大,{NEWLINE}但是因为经常战斗身上都臭臭的呢。{SCROLL}给你这个熏香{NEWLINE}改善一下你的精灵们的气味吧！
strings.en: Your Pokémon are strong, but all that{NEWLINE}battling has left them kind of stinky.{SCROLL}Here, take this incense to freshen them{NEWLINE}up!

strings.zh: 来吧,来一场青春热血{NEWLINE}充满活力的对战吧！
strings.en: Come on, let’s have a young,{NEWLINE}hot-blooded, energetic battle!

strings.zh: 你明明看起来那么年轻,{NEWLINE}却毫无身为训练家的斗志呢。
strings.en: You look so young, but you have none of{NEWLINE}a Trainer’s fighting spirit.

strings.zh: 在红莲道馆的时候{NEWLINE}我只是个打杂跑腿的小角色,{CLEAR}但是来到东南联盟之后,{CLEAR}我就成了众人仰望的火系大师了。{CLEAR}果然是树挪死、人挪活啊！
strings.en: At the Cinnabar Gym, I was just a lowly{NEWLINE}errand boy. But since coming to the{CLEAR}Southeast League, I’ve become a{CLEAR}Fire-type master everyone looks up to.{SCROLL}Move a tree and it dies; move a man and{NEWLINE}he thrives!

strings.zh: 哈哈哈,{NEWLINE}我的小宇宙燃烧起来了！
strings.en: Ha ha ha! My Cosmo is burning!

strings.zh: 你这看似冷静的外表下,{NEWLINE}有颗火热的心呢！{CLEAR}来吧,你配得上这个深红徽章……{SCROLL}…… ……{SCROLL}…… ……{SCROLL}哈哈哈,开玩笑的,{NEWLINE}我哪里有徽章啊,{CLEAR}送你块珍惜的石头吧！
strings.en: Beneath that cool exterior beats a{NEWLINE}fiery heart! Come, you are worthy of{CLEAR}this Volcano Badge...{SCROLL}... ...{SCROLL}... ...{SCROLL}Ha ha ha, just kidding. I don’t have any{NEWLINE}Badges!{SCROLL}Here, have a rare stone instead!

strings.zh: 我的化石翼龙可是这世界上最快的{NEWLINE}岩石系口袋妖怪,{CLEAR}你想感受一下我这化石翼龙的速度吗？
strings.en: My Aerodactyl is the fastest Rock-type{NEWLINE}Pokémon in the world. Want to feel that{CLEAR}speed for yourself?

strings.zh: 嘿嘿,被我给吓到了吗？
strings.en: Heh heh, did I scare you?

strings.zh: 我年轻的时候{NEWLINE}因为痴迷于美丽的女性,{CLEAR}于是四处留情沾花惹草。{CLEAR}最终无颜回家的我流浪到了这里,{CLEAR}才算是过上了稍微安稳点的生活。
strings.en: When I was young, I was so crazy about{NEWLINE}beautiful women that I left a trail of{CLEAR}flings and affairs everywhere I went.{SCROLL}In the end, too ashamed to go home, I{NEWLINE}drifted here, and only then did I settle{CLEAR}into a halfway quiet life.

strings.zh: 来吧,好好感受飞速岩石的冲击！
strings.en: Come on, feel the impact of flying rock!

strings.zh: 想不到小伙子你比我还快嘛,{NEWLINE}将来你一定会大受女孩子们欢迎的。{CLEAR}这个头盔送给你,{CLEAR}就当是我对你的祝福吧。
strings.en: Didn’t think you’d be even faster than{NEWLINE}me, young man. You’re going to be a big{CLEAR}hit with the girls someday. Take this{CLEAR}helmet as my blessing.

strings.zh: 哟,这位美女训练家,{NEWLINE}要通过一场精灵对战{CLEAR}开始我们的缘分吗？
strings.en: Well, hello there, pretty Trainer. Shall{NEWLINE}we start our destiny together with a{CLEAR}Pokémon battle?
strings.notes: #43–#47: old man hitting on a female player (#42 is the male-player version); kept faithful.

strings.zh: 何必这么害羞嘛。
strings.en: No need to be so shy.

strings.zh: 我感觉我们之间,{NEWLINE}会有产生刻骨铭心的爱情呢！
strings.en: I have a feeling a love we’ll never{NEWLINE}forget will bloom between us!
strings.notes: tone review: 刻骨铭心的爱情 = unforgettable love; 'love' kept to match #46/#47

strings.zh: 我被美女你那迷人的战斗身姿所吸引,{NEWLINE}已经无法自拔了。{CLEAR}这个坚硬的头盔作为我们的定情信物,{CLEAR}请你务必收下！
strings.en: Your charming battle style has{NEWLINE}captivated me completely. I can’t help{CLEAR}myself. Please accept this hard helmet{CLEAR}as a token of our love!

strings.zh: 虽然我儿子年龄比你还大,{NEWLINE}但我觉得只要咱们之间有爱情{CLEAR}年龄就不是障碍。
strings.en: My son may be older than you, but as{NEWLINE}long as there’s love between us, age is{CLEAR}no barrier.

strings.zh: 铁甲暴龙『Rhy——don！
strings.en: Rhydon: Rhy-don!

strings.zh: 玛力露丽『Azu——mari！
strings.en: Azumarill: Azu-mari!

strings.zh: 电栗鼠『Pachi——riz！
strings.en: Pachirisu: Pachi-riz!

strings.zh: 恰雷姆『Mediii——cham！
strings.en: Medicham: Mediii-cham!

strings.zh: 吞食兽『Swaaaa——lo！
strings.en: Swalot: Swaaaa-lo!

strings.zh: 沙漠蜻蜓『Fly——gon！
strings.en: Flygon: Fly-gon!

strings.zh: 大食花『Vic——Tree！
strings.en: Victreebel: Vic-Tree!

strings.zh: 虽然我们东南联盟的训练家们{NEWLINE}都不是职业的高级训练家,{CLEAR}但是连续跟他们战斗也并不容易呢。{SCROLL}您需要在我这里恢复一下精灵吗？
strings.en: Our Southeast League Trainers aren’t{NEWLINE}professional Senior Trainers, but{CLEAR}battling them one after another still{CLEAR}isn’t easy.{SCROLL}Would you like me to heal your Pokémon?

strings.zh: 精灵都恢复好了,{NEWLINE}祝您的训练家征程一路顺利！
strings.en: Your Pokémon are fully healed. Best of{NEWLINE}luck on your Trainer journey!

strings.zh: 煤炭龟『Tor——koal！
strings.en: Torkoal: Tor-koal!

strings.zh: 化石翼龙『Aeee——roda！
strings.en: Aerodactyl: Aeee-roda!

strings.zh: 我是东南联盟的最强训练家,{NEWLINE}东南联盟的冠军——阿故。{CLEAR}你如果想找我挑战的话,{CLEAR}就得先击败我们东南联盟的{CLEAR}8位代表训练家。
strings.en: I’m the strongest Trainer in the{NEWLINE}Southeast League, its Champion: Gus.{SCROLL}To challenge me, you’ll first have to{NEWLINE}beat the Southeast League’s eight{CLEAR}representative Trainers.

strings.zh: 我都听说了,你已经击败了{NEWLINE}我们东南联盟的8位代表训练家,{CLEAR}如果你能够再击败我,{CLEAR}那么这个东南联盟的冠军名号{CLEAR}就是你的了！
strings.en: I heard all about it. You’ve beaten the{NEWLINE}Southeast League’s eight{CLEAR}representative Trainers.{SCROLL}If you can beat me too, the title of{NEWLINE}Southeast League Champion is yours!

strings.zh: 我是四天王渡先生的粉丝,{NEWLINE}就是因为崇拜他我才专练龙精灵的。{CLEAR}奈何我天赋不够,{CLEAR}都没有资格去参加石英大会。{CLEAR}好在有东南联盟这个组织,{CLEAR}才让我过了一把当冠军的瘾。
strings.en: I’m a fan of Lance of the Elite Four. I{NEWLINE}specialize in Dragon types because I{CLEAR}idolize him. But I don’t have the talent,{CLEAR}and I never even qualified for the{CLEAR}Indigo Conference.{SCROLL}Luckily there’s the Southeast League,{NEWLINE}so I got a taste of being Champion.

strings.zh: 你赢了,恭喜你成为{NEWLINE}我们东南联盟的新任冠军。{CLEAR}这是成为冠军的纪念。
strings.en: You win. Congratulations on becoming{NEWLINE}the new Champion of the Southeast{CLEAR}League. Here’s a memento of your win.

strings.zh: 祝你在今后的旅行中{NEWLINE}能够一直获胜下去！
strings.en: May you keep on winning throughout your{NEWLINE}travels!

strings.zh: 嘿嘿,年轻的训练家,{NEWLINE}欢迎来到东南联盟！{SCROLL}需要我给你介绍一下东南联盟吗？
strings.en: Heh heh, young Trainer, welcome to the{NEWLINE}Southeast League!{SCROLL}Would you like me to tell you about it?

strings.zh: 那么祝您在我们东南联盟玩得愉快！
strings.en: Then enjoy your time in the Southeast{NEWLINE}League!

strings.zh: 我们东南联盟,{NEWLINE}是由一批业余训练家{CLEAR}组成的一个对战同好会。{SCROLL}联盟现在有1位冠军{NEWLINE}和8位代表训练家,{CLEAR}冠军象征着我们东南联盟的最强实力,{CLEAR}而8位代表训练家则是{CLEAR}代表着8种不同属性的训练家。{SCROLL}联盟成立的初衷就是为了给那些{NEWLINE}没有资格参加石英大会的训练家们,{CLEAR}提供一个更轻松的挑战舞台。{SCROLL}如果你想体验对战的乐趣,{NEWLINE}学习不同属性的对战技巧,{CLEAR}来我们东南联盟就对了。
strings.en: The Southeast League is a battle club{NEWLINE}made up of amateur Trainers.{SCROLL}Right now the League has one Champion{NEWLINE}and eight representative Trainers. The{CLEAR}Champion stands for the League’s{CLEAR}greatest strength, and the eight{CLEAR}representatives each stand for a{CLEAR}different type.{SCROLL}The League was founded to give Trainers{NEWLINE}who don’t qualify for the Indigo{CLEAR}Conference a more relaxed stage to{CLEAR}compete on.{SCROLL}If you want to enjoy battling and learn{NEWLINE}how to battle with different types, the{CLEAR}Southeast League is the place for you.

strings.zh: 口袋妖怪研究员的工作{NEWLINE}实在是太累了,{CLEAR}自从从事研究工作之后,{CLEAR}我的头发一天比一天少,{CLEAR}现在出门都只能带假发了。{CLEAR}好在还有东南联盟这个地方{CLEAR}可以放松一下。{CLEAR}这里的训练家都不是太强,{CLEAR}像我这样的弱者{CLEAR}在这里也有能取胜的机会。
strings.en: Working as a Pokémon researcher is just{NEWLINE}exhausting. Ever since I started doing{CLEAR}research, I’ve had less hair every day.{CLEAR}Now I have to wear a wig to go out.{SCROLL}Luckily, I can unwind here at the{NEWLINE}Southeast League. The Trainers here{CLEAR}aren’t too strong, so even a weakling{CLEAR}like me has a chance to win.

strings.zh: 我是个天文爱好者,{NEWLINE}根据我的观察,{CLEAR}传说中千年一遇的许愿之星{CLEAR}很可能在不久之后从天而降！
strings.en: I’m an amateur astronomer. According{NEWLINE}to my observations, the legendary{CLEAR}wishing star that comes only once in a{CLEAR}thousand years may fall from the sky{CLEAR}before long!

strings.zh: 东南联盟现任冠军——阿故！
strings.en: Southeast League Champion: Gus!
strings.notes: [D-0637 rename 2026-09-28: Kurt → Gus]

strings.zh: 东南联盟前任冠军——阿故！{SCROLL}东南联盟现任冠军——{VAR:0103:0}！
strings.en: Former Southeast League Champion:{NEWLINE}Gus!{SCROLL}Current Southeast League Champion:{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0}!
strings.notes: [D-0637 rename 2026-09-28: Kurt → Gus]

strings.zh: 请等一下！{SCROLL}南边的14号路正在进行{NEWLINE}口袋妖怪马拉松赛跑的准备工作。{SCROLL}那里的工作人员{NEWLINE}特意跟我们东南联盟打了招呼,{CLEAR}说是暂时请先不要过去。{CLEAR}所以这边暂时不能走哟。
strings.en: Please wait!{SCROLL}Route 14 to the south is getting ready{NEWLINE}for the Pokémon marathon race.{SCROLL}The staff there asked us at the{NEWLINE}Southeast League to keep people from{CLEAR}heading over for now. So you can’t go{CLEAR}this way for the time being.

strings.zh: 哇,你竟然能打败阿故！{NEWLINE}简直是我的偶像！{SCROLL}偶像,请收下来自你粉丝的礼物！
strings.en: Wow, you actually beat Gus! You’re my{NEWLINE}idol!{SCROLL}Idol, please accept this gift from your{NEWLINE}fan!
strings.notes: [D-0637 rename 2026-09-28: Kurt → Gus]

strings.zh: 偶像我跟你说哦,{NEWLINE}彩虹市的莉佳小姐{CLEAR}她对香水的品质要求太严格了,{CLEAR}我每天在店里996加班{CLEAR}都做不出她满意的香水。
strings.en: Hey, Idol, listen to this. Miss Erika in{NEWLINE}Celadon City is so strict about perfume{CLEAR}quality! I work 9-9-6 overtime at the{CLEAR}shop every day, and I still can’t make a{CLEAR}perfume she’s happy with.
strings.notes: 996 = the ‘9 a.m. to 9 p.m., six days a week’ overtime culture; kept as ‘9-9-6’.

strings.zh: 哇哈哈,你已经获得了{NEWLINE}咱们东南联盟的冠军了啊！{CLEAR}了不起了不起！{SCROLL}我这里有一只非常珍贵的尤基拉,{NEWLINE}因为太珍贵了{CLEAR}我都不不知道该怎么培养它,{CLEAR}但如果是获得冠军的你的话,{CLEAR}一定能发挥出这孩子的潜能。{CLEAR}就是不知道你是否愿意{CLEAR}带着我的小尤基拉一起旅行呢？
strings.en: Wa ha ha! You’ve become Champion of our{NEWLINE}Southeast League! Amazing, amazing!{SCROLL}I have a very precious Larvitar. It’s{NEWLINE}so precious that I don’t even know how{CLEAR}to raise it.{SCROLL}But a Champion like you could surely{NEWLINE}bring out this little one’s potential.{SCROLL}Would you be willing to take my little{NEWLINE}Larvitar along on your journey?

strings.zh: 连身为冠军的你也不知道{NEWLINE}该怎么培养尤基拉才好吗？
